name: YesAndSkylight
note: Private family tool. Off the public site and status dashboard by DESIGN D9. This data file exists for the bar-raise / constellation tooling only; it is not linked from any public surface.

barRaise.topFinding: Skylight shipped real work this week for the first time in three weeks, and it was the right work: f52a1c4 corrected DEFAULT_TIMEZONE from America/New_York to America/Chicago, which means every timed event the app wrote before 2026-07-24 was sent as wall clock in the wrong zone and landed an hour out on the physical frame. The fix corrects new writes only. Nothing has swept the events already on livinwithloynds that were written under the bad zone, and that sweep is the single most valuable thing left on this project right now. Alongside it, 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 added a required owner picker, the three-colour mapping in src/owners.ts, and a full recurrence builder in src/recur.ts with DST-aware UNTIL handling. That is 123 lines of date math and RRULE compilation shipped with zero tests, into a repo that still has no test runner at all, which is why maintainability-01 stays the highest-priority open action for a fourth run.

actions.title: Add a vitest suite over buildRrule, localToUtc, normDate, epochOf, addHour, nextDay, fmtWhen, resolveOwner, inferOwner and extractJson, and wire it into release.ps1 beside the typecheck.
Add a scheduled smoke probe that exercises one write per Skylight entity type and alerts on a 4xx.
List events on livinwithloynds created by the service account before 2026-07-24 and correct the ones sitting an hour out from the old America/New_York default.
Derive a deterministic event id from summary plus startsAt, pass it as Google's client-supplied id, and treat 409 as success.
Treat an unset or empty ALLOWED_SENDERS as reject-all rather than skipping the allowlist check.
Add a console.error in the index.ts fetch catch carrying pathname and error message, never the request body.
Extract the client script from ui.ts template literals into a typechecked source file and dedupe esc().
Correct the colour column in FAMILY_CALENDAR_MIGRATION.md section 5 so it matches the name-based rule recorded in section 4b.
Define one canonical event-input type and give both drivers a uniform createEvent signature.
Retry the Google events POST once on a 401 or 403 after re-minting the cached token.
Treat a 2xx write with an unreadable response body as success rather than throwing.
Wrap the whole email handler in a try/catch that logs and best-effort writes a KV entry.
Append the COUNT off-by-one warning to the /api/quick-add response message so API callers see what the form shows.
Fold a downstream check into /api/health, or point an external uptime probe at /api/setup.
Record processed Message-IDs in a short-TTL KV set and skip duplicates.
Redirect to sign-in on a 401 from /api/state or /api/quick-add instead of showing raw unauthorized.
Bump wrangler to ^4.x, regenerate the lockfile, and smoke-test a deploy.
Normalise both endpoints to one time frame before the start/end comparison, or reject a mixed pair.
